title: Retry policy maintenance with edge cases
final_response:
Patched `/work/retry_policy.py` to enforce its documented contract, keeping the signature `should_retry(method, status, attempt)`:

```python
def should_retry(method,status,attempt):
    """Retry GET/HEAD only, on 429 or 503, and only while attempt < 3. attempt starts at 1."""
    if not isinstance(method, str) or method.upper() not in ("GET", "HEAD"):
        return False
    if status not in (429, 503):
        return False
    try:
        return attempt < 3
    except TypeError:
        return False
```

The old body (`return status >= 500`) ignored method and attempt and wrongly retried 500/502/504.

Verification:
- `python3 test_visible.py` → `visible tests PASS`
- 34/34 additional edge cases passed, including: case-insensitive `get`/`Head`/`hEaD` accepted; `POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/OPTIONS/TRACE` rejected; 429 and 503 accepted, 500/502/504/404/400/200/None/`"429"` rejected; attempt 1–2 retried, 3 and 4 rejected, 0 retried (contract is `attempt < 3`); `None`/non-string method and `None`/string attempt return `False` instead of raising.
- `python3 -m py_compile` clean; `KEEP.txt` and `test_visible.py` untouched; generated `__pycache__` removed.
